discomName: West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd (WBSEDCL)

connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — WBERC Tariff Order dated 20.03.2025, per WBSEDCL 'Gist of Tariff Order 2025-26' (excluding erstwhile DPL area), https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/pdf/Tariff_Volumn/Gist%20of%20Tariff%20Order%202025-26_28_03.pdf. Rate A(CM) Commercial, quarterly slabs already match this file's quarterly billing cycle; fixed charge is Rs.60/kVA/month in the order, x3 = Rs.180/quarter. Excludes MVCA (monthly variable cost adjustment) and electricity duty.

PRIMARY — WBERC Tariff Order dated 20.03.2025, per WBSEDCL 'Gist of Tariff Order 2025-26', same URL as commercial. Rate B(I-U) Industry (Urban); order gives MONTHLY slabs (first 500 units: Rs.5.23, next 1500: Rs.7.86, above 2000: Rs.7.83) which have been x3'd here to match this file's quarterly billing cycle. Fixed charge Rs.75/kVA/month x3 = Rs.225/quarter. Rate B(I-R) Industry (Rural) is nearly identical (5.07/7.65/7.57) and not modelled separately. Excludes MVCA and electricity duty.

PRIMARY — WBERC Tariff Order dated 20.03.2025, per WBSEDCL 'Gist of Tariff Order 2025-26' Govt-subsidy annexure, same URL as commercial. Rate C(T) Irrigation pumping for Agriculture (metered) is a Time-of-Day tariff; this is the daytime (06:00-17:00) rate net of Govt of West Bengal subsidy (gross Rs.3.50, subsidy Rs.0.23). Evening peak (17:00-23:00) net rate is much higher (Rs.7.48/unit) and night (23:00-06:00) is Rs.2.42/unit — using a single flat rate here understates bills for evening-heavy usage since ToD billing isn't modelled. Fixed charge net of subsidy Rs.30/kVA/month (gross Rs.40, subsidy Rs.10), x3 = Rs.90/quarter.

verifiedBy: SOURCED (secondary) — WBSEDCL domestic quarterly slabs per WBERC order dated 20.03.2025 (eff 01.04.2025); fixed charge ₹30/kVA/month modelled as ₹90/kW per quarter. MVCA (monthly variable cost adjustment) and electricity duty NOT modelled. Pending primary WBERC order cross-check.
